browserEvidence.observation: Initial IAB navigation timed out and produced a white page with title only. One explicit reload recovered a fully usable home. No later persistent blank app observed.
MBA home selector changed example, guidance and CTA to audience=mba. First check had six named steps, role/company, editable pasted source and vacancy.

Removed ORCHID-LANTERN confidential line in source editor before comparison. Initial six requirements all Needs manual review. SQL absence, forecast/realized distinction, unfinished degree and team contribution retained full source wording.

Reporting requirement incorrectly selected negative direct-reports sentence first despite complete positive reporting evidence. Same contamination recurred for second vacancy's reporting and interviews/projects.

Edited one contribution sentence without new facts; Keep these edits in my reusable source offered Undo source update. Undo restored prior source and kept final edits. Reapplied source update; final preview showed exact edited wording and no ORCHID-LANTERN.

PDF preview generated a one-page count within two-page maximum. Approval required accuracy/privacy confirmations. After approval actual TXT, PDF and DOCX downloads were received; fallback download link/status appeared.

Help provided 12 detailed topics, search, walkthroughs, exact control names and recovery limits. Search confidential returned four topics but omitted dedicated source-line-removal topic.

Private CTA reached /auth?next=%2Floop; no sign-in attempted.

Selected Remove source line 6 for COBALT-PINE; Preview selected line removals displayed both CV versions without line. Applied removal removed it from both. Undo deliberately restored both with warning. Repeated removal; edited contribution and kept it in reusable source.

One-page PDF preview generated. Inline PDF area was blank. New-tab exact blob PDF fallback was blocked by browser security policy; no workaround attempted. Textual full CV review/accuracy/privacy approval still worked. Actual TXT, DOCX and separate evidence report downloads were received.

Undo restored sanitized original application at review without approval. Contextual How source-line removal works opened exact help anchor; return to check retained sanitized draft, cleared approvals and discarded page-only undo.

findings.title: Unrelated negation about direct reports contaminates stakeholder reporting
reproduction: Use MBA fixture reviewedSourceBeforeComparison and vacancy in a fresh guest check.
At evidence, open Produce stakeholder reports using Excel.
Observe Needs manual review and negative direct-reports sentence before the strong positive reporting sentence.
Repeat with second MBA vacancy; Prepare stakeholder reports using Excel remains incorrectly negative.
findings.impact: Hides a clear transferable strength, inflates manual-review work and tells a candidate they lack reporting experience when the negative concerns staff supervision.
findings.boundedAcceptance: With both minimal source lines present, reporting remains a direct/positive wording finding. A no-reporting-experience sentence must still trigger review; budget/team-leadership absence, SQL absence, project context and forecast qualifiers must remain conservative. Do not solve by stripping negative wording from the source.

findings.title: Confidential search omits the dedicated source-removal help
reproduction: Enter confidential in Search help topics.
Observe four matches; Remove selected source lines before reusing your CV is absent.
findings.impact: A discreet applicant looking for the removal operation is led through adjacent topics; contextual link works once the control has already been found.
findings.boundedAcceptance: The confidential query returns the dedicated source-removal topic, alongside relevant privacy material. Existing exact source/remove and contextual anchor navigation still work.

findings.title: Verified experience wording overstates what Jobvance establishes
reproduction: Read Busy professionals card: Reuse verified experience and keep confidential details out.
findings.impact: Verified can imply independent checking, while the rest of the product accurately explains user confirmation and literal wording only.
findings.boundedAcceptance: Use wording consistent with user-reviewed/confirmed experience. Do not imply independent credential or career-history verification.
